title: The Internet Named A Ship Boaty McBoatface. They Said No 🚢
caption:
The internet named a polar ship Boaty McBoatface 🚢
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 2016 Britain's Natural Environment Research Council asked the public to name a new polar research ship. Boaty McBoatface won with over 124,000 votes. The agency chose RRS Sir David Attenborough instead, and the Boaty name went to one of its remotely operated submarines.
Should they have listened? 👇
first_comment: The man who suggested it said he voted for Attenborough. Should they have listened to the internet? 🚢👇
